title: Governance Drift: Reproducibility Package
description: Manuscript source, closed-world detector study, canonical results, and a repeated bounded Kubernetes/GitOps laboratory for Governance Drift. Version 1.2.0 executes 20 repetitions of nine scenarios at 0.5-, 2-, and 10-second cadences (538/540 detections; 538/538 correct classifications conditional on detection), plus 20 benign windows with zero alarms in 543 polls. It separates injection, onset, detection, and evidence clocks. These results establish bounded realizability and within-laboratory behavior, not natural occurrence, field prevalence, or production effectiveness.
